|url-status=live }}</ref>

Dr. Mark Perlmutter, an American doctor working in Gaza, stated Israeli snipers were targeting children, stating, "No toddler gets shot twice by mistake by the 'world's best sniper.' And they're dead-center shots."<ref>{{cite web |last1=Smith |first1=Tracy |title=Children of Gaza |url=https://www.cbsnews.com/news/children-of-gaza/ |website=[[CBS News]] |date=21 July 2024 |access-date=3 August 2024 |archive-date=2 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240802213308/https://www.cbsnews.com/news/children-of-gaza/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In August 2024, an American doctor returning from Gaza stated, "We had kids shot in the chest and shot in the head – in other words, clearly deliberate, clearly targeted".<ref>{{cite web |last1=Maçães |first1=Bruno |title=What a surgeon saw in Gaza |url=https://www.newstatesman.com/world/middle-east/2024/08/what-a-surgeon-saw-in-gaza |website=[[The New Statesman]] |date=3 August 2024 |access-date=17 August 2024 |archive-date=17 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240817203608/https://www.newstatesman.com/world/middle-east/2024/08/what-a-surgeon-saw-in-gaza |url-status=live }}</ref> In October 2024, ''[[The New York Times]]'' reported compiled testimony from 44 doctors, nurses, and paramedics who treated multiple cases of preteen children with gunshot wounds to the head or chest in Gaza. Inquiries sent to the IDF regarding the experiences of these health care workers received a statement from a spokesperson that did not directly confirm whether investigations into the shootings of preteen children had been conducted or if any soldiers faced disciplinary action for firing at them.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2024/10/09/opinion/gaza-doctor-interviews.html|title=65 Doctors, Nurses and Paramedics: What We Saw in Gaza |last=Sidhwa |first=Feroze |date=9 October 2024 |work=[[The New York Times]] |archive-url=https://archive.today/20241012012500/https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2024/10/09/opinion/gaza-doctor-interviews.html |archive-date=12 October 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=12 October 2024}}</ref> In response to claims alleging that the report was based on "fabricated evidence", ''The New York Times'' issued a statement defending the integrity of the piece, emphasizing that it had undergone rigorous editing and verification, including consultations with experts and the use of supporting photographs, which they deemed "too horrific for publication."<ref>
*{{cite news |url=https://www.newarab.com/news/nyt-rebuts-claims-fake-images-gaza-children-shot-head |title=NYT rebuts pro-Israeli denial of scans showing Gaza children shot in head by soldiers |date=16 October 2024 |work=[[The New Arab]] |archive-url=https://archive.today/20241022011857/https://www.newarab.com/news/nyt-rebuts-claims-fake-images-gaza-children-shot-head |archive-date=22 October 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=22 October 2024}}
*{{cite web |url=https://www.thewrap.com/new-york-times-stands-by-report-child-gunshot-wounds-gaza/ |title=New York Times Stands By Report of Child Gunshot Wounds in Gaza: 'Rigorously Edited' and Double-Vetted |last=Dickey |first=Josh |date=16 October 2024 |work=[[The Wrap]] |archive-url=https://archive.today/20241022013025/https://www.thewrap.com/new-york-times-stands-by-report-child-gunshot-wounds-gaza/ |archive-date=22 October 2024 |url-status=live |access-date=22 October 2024}}</ref>

''[[De Volkskrant]]'' interviewed 17 doctors who had volunteered during the Gaza war. Fifteen of them reported seeing children with "a single gunshot wound to the head and/or chest." These doctors reported seeing 114 children injured this way. In response, former Commander of the Royal Netherlands Army [[Mart de Kruif]] told the paper, "If you're seeing a high number of gunshot wounds to the chest area and the head, that’s not collateral damage – that’s deliberate targeting."<ref>{{cite news |last1=Effting |first1=Maud |date=13 September 2025 |last2=Feenstra |first2=Willem |title=What the Wounds Are Telling Us |url=https://www.volkskrant.nl/kijkverder/v/2025/gunshot-palestine-children-israel-war~v1819649/ |access-date=14 September 2025 |work=[[De Volkskrant]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250913185156/https://www.volkskrant.nl/kijkverder/v/2025/gunshot-palestine-children-israel-war~v1819649/ |archive-date=13 September 2025 |language=en}}</ref> In one documented case, a girl was reportedly shot and killed while in her mother's arms.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Al-Sawalhi |first1=Mohammad |title=Palestinian girl shot in mother's arms as they attempted to return to home in northern Gaza |url=https://www.cnn.com/middleeast/live-news/israel-hamas-war-gaza-news-04-15-24/h_d1f23606cf67170b6218d0eb79762b4a |website=[[CNN]] |date=15 April 2024 |access-date=30 April 2024 |archive-date=30 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240430140747/https://www.cnn.com/middleeast/live-news/israel-hamas-war-gaza-news-04-15-24/h_d1f23606cf67170b6218d0eb79762b4a |url-status=live }}</ref>

In June 2026, a 94-page report by the UN [[Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory]] concluded there were reasonable grounds to determine that Israeli forces directly targeted children in Gaza using snipers and [[quadcopter|quadcopter drones]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Gritten |first1=David |last2=Hegarty |first2=Stephanie |title=UN commission of inquiry says Israel committing genocide in Gaza by deliberately targeting children |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0jy96w6pw2o |website=[[BBC]] |access-date=25 June 2026 |date=23 June 2026}}</ref>

==== Killing of Hind Rajab ====
{{main|Killing of Hind Rajab}}

[[File:Hind's Hall banner.jpg|thumb|A banner hangs from [[Columbia University|Columbia]]'s Hamilton Hall after protesters occupied the building, renaming it "Hind's Hall", 30 April 2024]]

===Injured===
[[File:Fars Photo of Casualties in Gaza Strip during 2023 War 26.jpg|thumb|Medic carried wounded child]]

Doctors described children experiencing serious injuries.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Shurafa |first1=Wafaa |title=Doctors visiting a Gaza hospital are stunned by the war's toll on Palestinian children |url=https://apnews.com/article/gaza-aqsa-martyrs-hospital-health-care-israel-7c7a6117efae29e22a61e82151144613 |website=Associated Press |date=28 March 2024 |access-date=4 May 2024 |archive-date=3 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240503225856/https://apnews.com/article/gaza-aqsa-martyrs-hospital-health-care-israel-7c7a6117efae29e22a61e82151144613 |url-status=live }}</ref> Doctors warned children who survived Israeli airstrikes were left with permanent disabilities and trauma.<ref name="Gaza’s children fight to survive">{{cite web |last1=Khaled |first1=Mai |last2=Saleh |first2=Heba |title=Gaza's children fight to survive amid wreckage of Israel-Hamas war |url=https://www.ft.com/content/55d74061-49c2-4a57-b67d-9daab07509fa?shareType=nongift |website=Financial Times |access-date=30 November 2023 |archive-date=1 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231201005616/https://www.ft.com/content/55d74061-49c2-4a57-b67d-9daab07509fa?shareType=nongift |url-status=live }}</ref> A report by Save the Children in January 2024 stated children were "enduring unspeakable horrors, including life-changing injuries, burns, disease, inadequate medical care, and losing their parents and other loved ones".<ref>{{cite web |title=More than 10,000 children killed in Gaza in nearly 100 days of war |url=https://m.reliefweb.int/report/4029165/occupied-palestinian-territory/gaza-10000-children-killed-nearly-100-days-war?lang=ru |website=[[ReliefWeb]] | date=11 January 2024 |publisher=Save the Children |access-date=13 January 2024 |archive-date=19 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240219160514/https://m.reliefweb.int/report/4029165/occupied-palestinian-territory/gaza-10000-children-killed-nearly-100-days-war?lang=ru |url-status=live }}</ref> A [[Doctors Without Borders]] doctor stated children were suffering from "terrible injuries, huge burns covering 50-70% of their body and massively broken limbs".<ref>{{cite web |title='Catastrophic scenes' at Nasser Hospital: MSF doctor |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/1/israels-war-on-gaza-live-death-toll-in-gaza-nears-27000-66000-wounded?update=2668088 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=3 February 2024 |archive-date=3 February 2024 |url-status=live }}</ref> Many of the surgeries performed on the children and other patients were performed without anesthesia due to severe shortages of medical supplies in Gaza, according to WHO.<ref name="cnn20240108" /> A doctor with [[Médecins Sans Frontières|Doctors Without Borders]] reflected that even after working in many war zones, he has seen more injured children in Gaza, stating; "It was really shocking for me because I have never seen babies. So many babies victim of trauma, of war, with war wounds".<ref name="cbc20240129" />

A British doctor who spent time in Gaza through a medical charity and returned to the United Kingdom in December 2023 highlighted the concerns of poor hygiene and medical supply shortages that could cause wounds to become worse and make some un-survivable. This was echoed by UNICEF spokesperson James Elder, who recounted seeing a child who had been stuck in a vehicle at an Israeli military checkpoint for days due to delays, with a wound that had started to decompose.<ref name="reuters20240104" /> In June 2024, children with cancer and other illnesses were prevented from receiving chemotherapy outside of the Gaza Strip when Israel closed the [[Rafah border crossing]] during its [[Rafah offensive]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Rouqa |first1=Doaa |title=Closure of Gaza's only route out leaves boy, 10, with no treatment for cancer |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/closure-gazas-only-route-out-leaves-boy-10-with-no-treatment-cancer-2024-06-04/ |website=Reuters |access-date=14 June 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url-status=live }}</ref> In July 2024, American and Australian doctors stated that Israel was using bombs that spray shrapnel, which were causing "horrific injuries" to children.<ref>{{cite news |url-status=live }}</ref>

[[File:Rescue attempt for one-year-old girl, 18 August 2024 - 3.jpg|thumb|200px|Rescue attempt for one-year-old girl in Gaza, 18 August 2024]]

In June 2024, [[Adam Hamawy]], a former US army combat surgeon who worked in the European Hospital, stated, "But the level of civilian casualties that I experienced was beyond anything I'd seen before... Most of our patients were children under the age of 14".<ref>{{cite web |title=US health workers sound alarm on Gaza medical crisis |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240627-us-health-workers-sound-alarm-on-gaza-medical-crisis |website=France24 |date=27 June 2024 |access-date=6 July 2024 |archive-date=6 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240706190131/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240627-us-health-workers-sound-alarm-on-gaza-medical-crisis |url-status=live }}</ref> In August 2024, an Israeli airstrike killed Joumana Arafa and her four-day-old twins.<ref>{{cite news |title=Four-day-old twins killed in Gaza by Israeli airstrike as father registered births |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/aug/14/twin-babies-killed-gaza-israeli-airstrike?CMP=twt_b-gdnnews |website=The Guardian | date=14 August 2024 |access-date=17 August 2024}}</ref>

====Amputations====
Save the Children reported 10 children a day in Gaza had lost their limbs, which would result in a lifetime of medical needs.<ref>{{cite web |title=GAZA: MORE THAN 10 CHILDREN A DAY LOSE A LIMB IN THREE MONTHS OF BRUTAL CONFLICT |url=https://www.savethechildren.net/news/gaza-more-10-children-day-lose-limb-three-months-brutal-conflict |website=Save the Children |date=7 January 2024 |access-date=8 January 2024 |archive-date=8 January 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240108000556/https://www.savethechildren.net/news/gaza-more-10-children-day-lose-limb-three-months-brutal-conflict |url-status=live }}</ref> A UNICEF spokesperson James Elder was quoted after returning from Gaza in mid-December 2023, that around 1,000 children had lost one or both legs since the 7 October attacks and the start of the war. According to the British doctor [[Ghassan Abu-Sittah]], "This is the biggest cohort of pediatric amputees in history".<ref>{{cite magazine |last1=Griswold |first1=Eliza |title=The Children Who Lost Limbs in Gaza |url=https://www.newyorker.com/news/dispatch/the-children-who-lost-limbs-in-gaza?utm_medium=social&utm_brand=tny&utm_social-type=owned&mbid=social_twitter&utm_source=twitter |magazine=The New Yorker |date=21 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240322004534/https://www.newyorker.com/news/dispatch/the-children-who-lost-limbs-in-gaza?utm_medium=social&utm_brand=tny&utm_social-type=owned&mbid=social_twitter&utm_source=twitter |access-date=24 March 2024|archive-date=22 March 2024 }}</ref>

In mid-December 2023, a teenager's [[amputation]] performed without anesthesia on her families kitchen table by her uncle who is a doctor went viral on social media. She and a sibling had climbed to the top of the building to call their father who is overseas before the building was reportedly struck by IDF tank fire, and she was rushed inside to her uncle.<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 January 2024 |title=Gaza doctor amputates niece's leg at home, without anaesthesia |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gaza-doctor-amputates-nieces-leg-home-without-anaesthesia-2024-01-19/ |access-date=11 March 2024 |website=Reuters |archive-date=11 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240311195156/https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gaza-doctor-amputates-nieces-leg-home-without-anaesthesia-2024-01-19/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last1=Mahfouz |first1=Heba Farouk |last2=Morris |first2=Loveday |date=20 January 2024 |title=A kitchen table amputation without anesthetic in Gaza is one of many |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/01/20/gaza-healthcare-crisis-amputation-anesthesia/ |access-date=11 March 2024 |newspaper=Washington Post |language=en-US |issn=0190-8286 |archive-date=2 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240502223718/https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/01/20/gaza-healthcare-crisis-amputation-anesthesia/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In early-January 2024, an 11-year-old speaking to reporters about her injuries which included an amputated leg and with the other severely injured expressed her hope in getting an [[Prosthesis|artificial limb]], and lamented how her life has become "ugly and sad" after the injury.<ref name="reuters20240104" /> Other children's stumps after amputation had to be re-opened after infections had set in.<ref name="reuters20240104" />

By June 2024, doctors in Gaza estimated as many as 3,000 children had lost limbs since October 2023.<ref>{{cite web |title=Almost 3,000 Palestinian children have lost limbs in Israel's attacks on Gaza |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/6/8/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israeli-army-to-be-added-to-un-child-harm-list?update=2960201 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=16 June 2024 |archive-date=16 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240616163343/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/6/8/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israeli-army-to-be-added-to-un-child-harm-list?update=2960201 |url-status=live }}</ref> A WHO Emergency Medical Team coordinator also cautioned that due to lack of medical expertise and time, some of the amputations done were unnecessary or due to a time delay.<ref name="cbc20240129" /> The head of [[Humanity & Inclusion]] stated child amputees needed "immediate support" for prosthetics but that wasn't happening.<ref>{{cite web |title=Not enough support for amputees in Gaza, says charity |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/6/15/israels-war-on-gaza-live-1-million-exhausted-people-trapped-in-south?update=2976961 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=23 June 2024 |archive-date=23 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240623215933/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/6/15/israels-war-on-gaza-live-1-million-exhausted-people-trapped-in-south?update=2976961 |url-status=live }}</ref> In January 2025, UNICEF estimated that up to 4,000 children in Gaza had lost one or more limbs.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Moor |first1=Ahmed |title=There are more child amputees in Gaza than anywhere else in the world. What can the future hold for them? |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/ng-interactive/2025/mar/27/gaza-palestine-children-injuries |work=The Guardian |date=27 March 2025}}</ref>

=== Orphaned ===
In November 2023, one month into the war, aid workers began using the term WCNSF (“[[Wounded Child No Surviving Family]]”) to describe children who had been injured and lost all family members.<ref name="Gaza’s children fight to survive"/><ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-11-07 |title=Gaza coins a new acronym: WCNSF - Wounded Child No Surviving Family |url=https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20231107-gaza-coins-a-new-acronym-wcnsf-wounded-child-no-surviving-family/ |work=[[Middle East Monitor]]}}</ref> In late-August 2024, an estimated 19,000 children had lost one or both of their parents.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Saleh |first1=Heba |title='My siblings have become my children': the plight of Gaza's orphans |url=https://www.ft.com/content/a00ef9da-c33c-4928-8f5a-ff12a2da04ef?shareType=nongift |website=Financial Times |access-date=14 September 2024 |archive-date=14 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240914055158/https://www.ft.com/content/a00ef9da-c33c-4928-8f5a-ff12a2da04ef?shareType=nongift |url-status=live }}</ref> UNICEF reported that extended families were taking on the responsibility of caring for orphaned children.<ref>{{cite web |title=Families struggling to take care of additional children orphaned in Gaza |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/2/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israel-downplays-settler-violence-in-west-bank?update=2672875 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=3 February 2024 |archive-date=2 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240202204219/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/2/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israel-downplays-settler-violence-in-west-bank?update=2672875 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Many orphaned children described the pain of being unable to properly say goodbye to their parents and siblings, due to lack of funeral or memorial services, uncertainty of the future and delay at being told due to medical fragility.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Mousa |first1=Aseel |last2=Borger |first2=Julian |date=22 December 2023 |title=The plight of Gaza's 'WCNSFs' – wounded child, no surviving family |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/dec/22/the-plight-of-gazas-wcnsfs-wounded-child-no-surviving-family |access-date=14 February 2024 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077 |archive-date=14 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240214190137/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/dec/22/the-plight-of-gazas-wcnsfs-wounded-child-no-surviving-family |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="bbc20231204" /> Older siblings and extended family also took on responsibility for caring for their younger siblings after being orphaned.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Humaid |first1=Maram |title=Two orphaned teens got their seven siblings to Rafah; now they live in fear |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2024/2/12/two-orphaned-teens-got-their-seven-siblings-to-rafah-now-they-live-in-fear |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=17 February 2024 |archive-date=17 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240217172827/https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2024/2/12/two-orphaned-teens-got-their-seven-siblings-to-rafah-now-they-live-in-fear |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Gaza's orphaned children are bearing the brunt of the war as relatives struggle to provide support |url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/video/lifestyle/gaza’s-orphaned-children-are-bearing-the-brunt-of-the-war-as-relatives-struggle-to-provide-support/vi-BB1pCJzg#details |website=MSN |publisher=Al Jazeera English |access-date=20 July 2024}}</ref>

In early February 2024, UNICEF estimated that at least 17,000 children had been orphaned.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Sebouai |first1=Lilia |title='They've lost everything': What now for Gaza's 17,000 orphans? |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/global-health/terror-and-security/gaza-17000-orphans-palestine-israel-hamas-war/ |website=The Telegraph |access-date=8 March 2024 |date=7 February 2024 |archive-date=8 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240308015605/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/global-health/terror-and-security/gaza-17000-orphans-palestine-israel-hamas-war/ |url-status=live }}</ref> Some children were left without even extended family remaining.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Shurafa |first1=Wafaa |title=Israeli strikes on Gaza leave children without parents and parents without children |url=https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-gaza-orphans-strikes-36c11d9bb2c01b094e4301bf4e197f0b?utm_campaign=TrueAnthem&utm_medium=AP&utm_source=Twitter |website=Associated Press |date=13 August 2024 |access-date=17 August 2024 |archive-date=17 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240817231710/https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-gaza-orphans-strikes-36c11d9bb2c01b094e4301bf4e197f0b?utm_campaign=TrueAnthem&utm_medium=AP&utm_source=Twitter |url-status=live }}</ref> In the Middle East, adoption by non-relatives is uncommon, as extended families traditionally assume responsibility for orphaned children. However, UNICEF reports that families already struggling to feed and shelter their own children are often unable or unwilling to take in additional dependents.<ref>{{cite web | title=Discovered in a tree after her Gaza home was destroyed, Baby Unknown finds a new family with her doctor | website=NBC News | date=2024-04-11 | url=https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/israel-hamas-war-gaza-rafah-baby-unknown-al-shifa-incubator-malak-rcna146150 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240411181643/https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/israel-hamas-war-gaza-rafah-baby-unknown-al-shifa-incubator-malak-rcna146150 | archive-date=2024-04-11 | url-status=live | access-date=2025-10-12}}</ref> By October 2024, the estimated number of orphans in Gaza had grown to 20,000.<ref>{{cite web |title=Surviving war: A day in the life of one of Gaza's 20,000 new orphans |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S871wBrfd7s |website=YouTube | date=25 October 2024 |publisher=Channel 4 News |access-date=2 November 2024 |archive-date=31 October 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241031133851/https://www.youtube.com/watch?si=scMU1tio3loGupCK&v=S871wBrfd7s&feature=youtu.be |url-status=live }}</ref>

In early September 2025, 2,596 children had lost both parents, according to UNICEF, citing figures from Gaza's health ministry. Furthermore, 53,724 children had lost one parent, 47,804 their father and 5,920 their mother.<ref name=nofamn>{{cite web | last1=Borger | first1=Julian | last2=Tantesh | first2=Seham | title=No family, no stability, no social fabric: the anguish of Gaza's wounded orphans | website=the Guardian | date=2025-10-10 | url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/oct/10/no-family-stability-social-fabric-harm-inflicted-gaza-children-incalculable | access-date=2025-10-11}}</ref> No figures are available on how many orphaned children also had been injured, but Gaza was reported to have the highest proportion of child amputations of any contemporary conflict.<ref name=nofamn/> Medical workers said that while they can provide treatment for children's physical injuries, there is little lasting stability or support afterward. With most social institutions in collapse, only small community networks and aid groups remain to care for orphaned children or try to locate surviving relatives, efforts that are minimal compared with the overwhelming need.<ref name=nofamn/> [[War Child (charity)|War Child]] is among the few humanitarian organisations contacted by emergency clinics about WCNSF cases. Its social workers search displacement camps for unaccompanied children and work to place them with adults willing to provide care. However, locating families willing to take in children is exceptionally difficult amid severe food shortages, and transporting a wounded child is very expensive.<ref name=nofamn/> Amid worsening scarcity, many children, particularly boys, are banding together to survive, searching through rubbish for food or items to sell, and gathering in groups at food distribution sites, a perilous strategy born of extreme need.<ref name=nofamn/>

==== Evacuations to Bethlehem ====
In March 2024, Israel brought 95 Palestinian orphans from [[Rafah]] to the [[SOS Children's Villages|SOS Children's]] orphanage in [[Bethlehem]] at the request of the German government.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Nobani |first1=Ayman |title=Settlers denounce moving of Palestinian orphans in Gaza to Bethlehem |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/3/11/israels-war-on-gaza-live-ramadan-begins-with-no-end-to-israels-siege?update=2766071 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=14 March 2024 |archive-date=14 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240314032328/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/3/11/israels-war-on-gaza-live-ramadan-begins-with-no-end-to-israels-siege?update=2766071 |url-status=live }}</ref> Israeli finance minister [[Bezalel Smotrich]] condemned the temporary measure, stating, "Any mercy to the cruel will end up being cruel to the merciful".<ref>{{cite web |title=Rafah orphans taken to Bethlehem 'not relocated permanently': Germany |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/3/12/israels-war-on-gaza-live-2000-medical-staff-starving-in-north-ministry?update=2768254 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=14 March 2024 |archive-date=14 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240314233214/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/3/12/israels-war-on-gaza-live-2000-medical-staff-starving-in-north-ministry?update=2768254 |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Displacement==
{{Main|Gaza Strip evacuations}}

[[File:Forced Displacement of Gaza Strip Residents During 23-25..jpg|thumb|Displaced Palestinians in Gaza on 29 January 2025]] 
On 13 November 2023, [[UNICEF]] reported that more than 1.5 million people in Gaza, including about 700,000 children, had been [[Forced displacement|displaced]].<ref name="UNICEF101123"/><ref>{{cite web | title=UNICEF: More Than 700,000 Children in Gaza Displaced | website=CNN | date=2023-11-20 | url=https://edition.cnn.com/videos/world/2023/11/20/exp-unicef-children-gaza-live-intv-112010aseg2-cnni-world.cnn | access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref> Nine days later, UNICEF reported "increasing numbers" of [[Unaccompanied minor|unaccompanied children]] had been identified evacuating from northern to southern Gaza by themselves.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Russell |first1=Catherine |title=UNICEF Executive Director Catherine Russell's remarks at the UN Security Council briefing on the protection of children in Gaza |url=https://www.unicef.org/press-releases/unicef-executive-director-catherine-russells-remarks-un-security-council-briefing |website=UNICEF |access-date=27 November 2023 |archive-date=27 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231127002149/https://www.unicef.org/press-releases/unicef-executive-director-catherine-russells-remarks-un-security-council-briefing |url-status=live }}</ref> On 28 November, James Elder, a UNICEF spokesperson, stated wounded children were sheltering outdoors in [[Parking lot|car parks]] and gardens.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Arslan |first1=Muhammet İkbal |title=Situation in Gaza 'worse than I imagined': UNICEF spokesperson tells Anadolu |url=https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/situation-in-gaza-worse-than-i-imagined-unicef-spokesperson-tells-anadolu/3067410 |website=AA |access-date=29 November 2023 |archive-date=29 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231129002126/https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/situation-in-gaza-worse-than-i-imagined-unicef-spokesperson-tells-anadolu/3067410 |url-status=live }}</ref>

By December 2023, [[Save the Children]] reported that it is likely that about 893,000 children were internally displaced in Gaza, average of 12,000 children a day forced to flee their homes, with some having to evacuate multiple times. Of the about 1.9 million displaced people in southern Gaza children make up almost 50% of the evacuees.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ramallah |date=22 December 2023 |title=12,000 CHILDREN A DAY FORCIBLY DISPLACED IN GAZA, AS NEW 'EVACUATION ORDERS' ISSUED TO CIVILIANS |url=https://www.savethechildren.net/news/12000-children-day-forcibly-displaced-gaza-new-evacuation-orders-issued-civilians |access-date=5 February 2024 |website=Save the Children |archive-date=5 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240205212051/https://www.savethechildren.net/news/12000-children-day-forcibly-displaced-gaza-new-evacuation-orders-issued-civilians |url-status=live }}</ref> On 9 February, Catherine Russell stated, "UNICEF is urgently calling on the parties to refrain from military escalation in Rafah Governate in Gaza where over 600,000 children and their families have been displaced – many of them more than once."<ref>{{cite web |title=UNICEF chief calls on Israel to 'refrain from military escalation' in Rafah |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/9/israels-war-on-gaza-live-fear-in-rafah-as-israel-prepares-ground-attack?update=2693204 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=11 February 2024 |archive-date=9 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240209035154/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/9/israels-war-on-gaza-live-fear-in-rafah-as-israel-prepares-ground-attack?update=2693204 |url-status=live }}</ref>

As Israel began its [[Rafah offensive]] in early-May 2024, Save the Children stated, "Forcibly displacing people from Rafah while further disrupting the aid response will likely seal the fate of many children".<ref>{{cite web |title=Save the Children warns of deadly consequences for children following new relocation orders for families in Rafah |url=https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/save-children-warns-deadly-consequences-children-following-new-relocation-orders-families-rafah |website=ReliefWeb |date=6 May 2024 |publisher=Save the Children |access-date=11 May 2024 |archive-date=8 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240708152110/https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/save-children-warns-deadly-consequences-children-following-new-relocation-orders-families-rafah |url-status=live }}</ref>

According to [[UNRWA]], as of 10 March 2024, there are over 187,000 individuals who have recently been displaced in Gaza. A significant number of these individuals, including numerous children, have sought refuge in UNRWA schools. Unfortunately, some of the facilities providing shelter to these displaced families, such as schools, have also suffered damage.<ref>[https://www.unicef.org/press-releases/pain-suffering-engulfs-children-state-palestine-israel Pain & suffering engulfs children] Retrieved 10 March 2024</ref>

In January 2025, it was estimated that over 90% of Gaza's population had been displaced.<ref name=sufbyd>{{cite web | title=Suffering by design | url=https://drc.ngo/media/ieul0lw0/drc-parc-and-wac-report-suffering-by-design.pdf | access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref> Also the [[United Nations]] reported in May 2025 that at least 1.9 million people,  roughly 90 percent of Gaza's population, had been displaced by the war. Many families had been uprooted repeatedly, in some cases more than ten times, and new evacuation orders have continued to drive further displacement.<ref>{{cite web | title=UNRWA Situation Report #173 on the Humanitarian Crisis in the Gaza Strip and the West Bank, including East Jerusalem | website=UNRWA | date=2025-05-30 | url=https://www.unrwa.org/resources/reports/unrwa-situation-report-173-situation-gaza-strip-and-west-bank-including-east-jerusalem | access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref> Families in Gaza largely have no safe place to go. Displacement sites are packed and conditions are unsafe and undignified. Even where space exists, many lack tents or basic shelter materials, and tented areas themselves continue to come under bombardment.<ref>{{cite web | title=Humanitarian Situation Update #321 | website=OCHA | date=2023-10-07 | url=https://www.unocha.org/publications/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/humanitarian-situation-update-321-gaza-strip | access-date=2025-10-05}}</ref>

===Missing and identification===
According to UNICEF, the standard system for identifying, documenting, tracing and reuniting children with relatives or siblings was barely functional in early December 2023.<ref name="bbc20231204">{{Cite news |last=Haidar |first=Dalia |date=4 December 2023 |title='Wounded child, no surviving family': The pain of Gaza's orphans |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-67614139 |access-date=14 February 2024 |language=en-GB |archive-date=14 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240214190137/https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-67614139 |url-status=live }}</ref> Additional difficulties arose from the intensity of the fighting and the rapidly changing conditions in Gaza, which hindered efforts to communicate with hospitals and medical staff.<ref name="bbc20231204" /> Four months into the conflict, the UN estimated that about 40% of all people in Gaza had lost identification cards and documents due to the war, making it more difficult to identify unaccompanied children and reunite them with their families.<ref name="aljazeera20240215" /> Humanitarian organizations also reported difficulties with orphaned children who were too young to know their own names.<ref name="aljazeera20240215" /> A UNICEF spokesman said: "The youngest ones very often cannot say their name and even the older ones are usually in shock so it can be extremely difficult to identify them".<ref>{{cite news |last1=Knell |first1=Yolande |title=Injured, hungry and alone - the Gazan children orphaned by war |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-68141039?xtor=AL-72-%5Bpartner%5D-%5Bbbc.news.twitter%5D-%5Bheadline%5D-%5Bnews%5D-%5Bbizdev%5D-%5Bisapi%5D&at_campaign=Social_Flow&at_link_type=web_link&at_campaign_type=owned&at_link_id=3BEE18E6-BFFE-11EE-AD3E-B4B2D0B4AF07&at_link_origin=BBCWorld&at_format=link&at_medium=social&at_ptr_name=twitter&at_bbc_team=editorial |website=BBC |date=31 January 2024 |access-date=7 February 2024 |archive-date=7 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240207012514/https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-68141039?xtor=AL-72-%5Bpartner%5D-%5Bbbc.news.twitter%5D-%5Bheadline%5D-%5Bnews%5D-%5Bbizdev%5D-%5Bisapi%5D&at_campaign=Social_Flow&at_link_type=web_link&at_campaign_type=owned&at_link_id=3BEE18E6-BFFE-11EE-AD3E-B4B2D0B4AF07&at_link_origin=BBCWorld&at_format=link&at_medium=social&at_ptr_name=twitter&at_bbc_team=editorial |url-status=live }}</ref>

Hospital and emergency workers in Gaza noted that parents and relatives of some children wrote on children's bodies, mostly on their legs and abdomens, so the children would be identifiable if found in the rubble or get lost. One employee stated: "Many of the children are missing, many get here with their skulls broken… and it’s impossible to identify them, only through that writing do they get identified."<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Salman |first1=Abeer |last2=Khadder |first2=Kareem |last3=El Damanhoury |first3=Kareem |last4=Mogul |first4=Rhea |last5=Said-Moorhouse |first5=Lauren |date=23 October 2023 |title=Names written on children's bodies speak to the fears of Gazan parents amid the Israel-Hamas war |url=https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/23/middleeast/gaza-hospitals-doctors-disaster-intl-hnk/index.html |access-date=6 February 2024 |website=CNN |language=en |archive-date=6 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240206194643/https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/23/middleeast/gaza-hospitals-doctors-disaster-intl-hnk/index.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

In June 2024, [[Save the Children]] stated approximately 21,000 children were missing in Gaza, including 4,000 children believed to be buried under rubble.<ref>{{cite web |title=Gaza's Missing Children: Over 20,000 Children Estimated to Be Lost, Disappeared, Detained, Buried Under The Rubble Or In Mass Graves |url=https://www.savethechildren.net/news/gazas-missing-children-over-20000-children-estimated-be-lost-disappeared-detained-buried-under#:~:text=%5B1%5D%20Save%20the%20Children%20estimates,in%20Gaza%2C%20or%20over%2020%2C000. |website=Save the Children | date=24 June 2024 |access-date=3 July 2024 |archive-date=2 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240702111204/https://www.savethechildren.net/news/gazas-missing-children-over-20000-children-estimated-be-lost-disappeared-detained-buried-under#:~:text=%5B1%5D%20Save%20the%20Children%20estimates,in%20Gaza%2C%20or%20over%2020%2C000. |url-status=live }}</ref> The bodies of some of these children remained unrecovered.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Natour |first1=Rhana |title=These Palestinian boys received life-saving surgery in the US. An Israeli airstrike killed them in their home |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/28/palestine-children-surgery-gaza-israel-airstrike-killed |website=The Guardian |date=28 November 2023 |access-date=30 November 2023 |archive-date=30 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231130001334/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/28/palestine-children-surgery-gaza-israel-airstrike-killed |url-status=live }}</ref> In one case, a newborn was rescued from under rubble after surviving a bombing.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Barbakh |first1=Arafat |title=Baby saved from Gaza rubble after mother killed in Israeli strike |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/baby-saved-gaza-rubble-after-mother-killed-israeli-strike-2023-12-29/ |website=Reuters |date=29 December 2023 |access-date=7 January 2024 |archive-date=6 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240206163220/http://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/baby-saved-gaza-rubble-after-mother-killed-israeli-strike-2023-12-29/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In another, a girl was rescued after being buried for more than 40 hours.<ref>{{cite web |title=Child saved from destroyed home in Khan Younis: PRCS |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/3/5/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israeli-attacks-on-aid-seekers-continue?update=2751199 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=8 March 2024 |archive-date=8 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240308013720/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/3/5/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israeli-attacks-on-aid-seekers-continue?update=2751199 |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Education==
{{further|Attacks on schools during the Gaza war}}
[[File:Destruction of UNRWA Zaitoun Boys School, Gaza Strip.jpg|thumb|A destroyed UNRWA school in [[Zaytun Quarter|Zaytun]] in February 2024]]
Before the war, education in the Gaza Strip was seen as a point of pride and a high priority. More than 95% of the children aged between 6-12 were attending school, with the majority graduating from high school.<ref name="npr20231019" /> In December 2023, Jonathan Crick, a spokesperson for [[UNICEF]] in Jerusalem stated that there is absolutely no form of education or schooling in the Gaza Strip, and the about 625,000 school age children in the Strip are being deprived of an education due to war.<ref name="theguardian20231218">{{Cite news |last1=Mousa |first1=Aseel |last2=Graham-Harrison |first2=Emma |date=18 December 2023 |title=War's toll on education in Gaza casts shadow over children's future |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/dec/18/wars-toll-on-education-in-gaza-casts-shadow-over-childrens-future |access-date=5 February 2024 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077 |archive-date=5 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240205202905/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/dec/18/wars-toll-on-education-in-gaza-casts-shadow-over-childrens-future |url-status=live }}</ref> In January 2024, the United Nations reported that children in Gaza would lose at least one year of education due to the war.<ref>{{cite web |title=Gaza: A struggle to keep young hopes alive, amid shattered dreams |url=https://news.un.org/en/story/2024/01/1146102 |website=United Nations |date=31 January 2024 |access-date=4 February 2024 |archive-date=4 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240204043011/https://news.un.org/en/story/2024/01/1146102 |url-status=live }}</ref> According to the Palestinian Ministry of Education, the war has caused the death of about 4,327 students and injured about 7, 819 others by January 2024.<ref name="middleeasteye20240131">{{Cite web |last=Hearst |first=Katherine |date=31 January 2024 |title=Killing of Gaza's academics amounts to 'educide,' say campaigners |url=https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/war-gaza-israel-killing-academics-educide-campaigners-say |access-date=5 February 2024 |website=Middle East Eye |language=en |archive-date=5 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240205205755/https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/war-gaza-israel-killing-academics-educide-campaigners-say |url-status=live }}</ref> Additionally at least 200 teachers have been killed and more than 500 injured by December 2023<ref name="theguardian20231218" /> with the number increasing to 231 teachers and administrators killed and 756 wounded by January 2024.<ref name="middleeasteye20240131" />

Schools were closed at the start of the war, and underwent [[Attacks on schools during the Israeli invasion of Gaza|sustained bombing]] by the Israeli military, while others, such as the [[Israa University (Palestine)#2023–2024 Israeli occupation and destruction|Israa University]], were occupied and then destroyed by the Israeli military.<ref>{{cite web |title=Children Suffer as Education Under Attack in the West Bank and Gaza |url=https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/children-suffer-education-under-attack-west-bank-and-gaza |website=ReliefWeb |date=February 2024 }}</ref><ref name="middleeasteye20240131" /> By mid-December 2023 about 352 school buildings had been damaged, which is over 70% of the Strip's education infrastructure, with others being utilized to hold evacuated individuals and interiors utilized for fuel and survival.<ref name="theguardian20231218" /> Some teachers attempted to continue lessons as they could, in courtyards and other areas not of education and warned that the "majority of them may never return to school again".<ref>{{cite web |title=A year of silence in Gaza's classrooms: the urgent need for educational revival |url-status=live }}</ref> Some students enrolled in online classes or learned in tent classrooms.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Murray |first1=Clara |title=The Gazan teenagers defying war for competitive 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241107014658/https://www.ft.com/content/e2b56356-f03d-49e2-95f5-cb6742f7176f?shareType=nongift |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Teachers As of January 2025, children in Gaza had been without formal schooling for over a year. While some informal classes reportedly take place in displacement camps, parents say their children are falling behind academically, forgetting basic literacy skills, or losing crucial years of education altogether.<ref name=sufbyd/>

== Involvement of children in military operations ==

=== Use as human shields by Israel===
{{See also|Human shields in the Israeli–Palestinian conflict#Use by Israeli forces}}

Israel has used Palestinian children as human shields in Gaza in violation of Geneva conventions.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Tantesh |first1=Malak A. |last2=Borger |first2=Julian |last3=Taha |first3=Sufian |date=21 October 2024 |title=Palestinians describe being used as 'human shields' by Israeli troops in Gaza |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/21/palestinians-describe-being-used-as-human-shields-by-israeli-troops-in-gaza |access-date=28 November 2024 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref> Human rights groups have said that "even if Hamas were using human shields", Israel must still abide by [[international law]], especially the principle of [[Proportionality (International Humanitarian Law)|proportionality]].<ref>{{cite web |date=25 July 2014 |title=Israel/Gaza conflict: Questions and Answers |url=https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2014/07/israelgaza-conflict-questions-and-answers/ |access-date=6 December 2023 |website=Amnesty International |archive-date=15 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231215192356/https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2014/07/israelgaza-conflict-questions-and-answers/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Protect civilians from the impact of hostilities |date=27 October 2023 |website=B'tselem |url=http://www.btselem.org/press_releases/20231027_protect_civilians_from_the_impact_of_hostilities |access-date=29 November 2024 |archive-date=2 January 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240102215900/https://www.btselem.org/press_releases/20231027_protect_civilians_from_the_impact_of_hostilities |url-status=live }}</ref>

In May 2023, before the beginning of the [[Gaza war]], [[Defence for Children International]] – Palestine (DCIP) had already documented that five children had been used as human shields by the Israeli army since the beginning of that year, with two of the victims being 2-year-old twins.<ref>{{cite news |date=18 May 2023 |title=Israeli forces use five Palestinian children as human shields |url=https://www.dci-palestine.org/israeli_forces_use_five_palestinian_children_as_human_shields |access-date=26 June 2024 |publisher=Defence for Children International |archive-date=18 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240518123408/https://www.dci-palestine.org/israeli_forces_use_five_palestinian_children_as_human_shields |url-status=live }}</ref>

According to a 2024 ''[[Haaretz]]'' investigation based on many Israeli soldiers' testimony, Palestinian teenagers, adults, and occasionally elderly men are regularly used as human shields to explore the tunnel network in the Gaza Strip. These ''shawashim'' are dressed up, apart from sandshoes, to look like Israeli soldiers, handcuffed, blindfolded and, with a video camera attached to their bodies, sent into houses where Hamas combatants are suspected to hide, or into tunnels that might be booby-trapped. The practice is said to be widely known to IDF field commanders.<ref>Yaniv Kubovich, Michael Hauser Tov, [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2024-08-13/ty-article-magazine/.premium/idf-uses-gazan-civilians-as-human-shields-to-inspect-potentially-booby-trapped-tunnels/00000191-4c84-d7fd-a7f5-7db6b99e0000 Haaretz Investigation: Israeli Army Uses Palestinian Civilians to Inspect Potentially Booby-trapped Tunnels in Gaza] [[Haaretz]] 13 August 2024</ref><ref name="nytimes20241014">{{Cite news |last1=Odenheimer |first1=Natan |last2=Shbair |first2=Bilal |last3=Kingsley |first3=Patrick |date=14 October 2024 |title=How Israel's Army Uses Palestinians as Human Shields in Gaza |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2024/10/14/world/middleeast/israel-gaza-military-human-shields.html |access-date=16 October 2024 |work=[[The New York Times]] |archive-date=1 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241201203852/https://www.nytimes.com/2024/10/14/world/middleeast/israel-gaza-military-human-shields.html |url-status=live }}</ref> Palestinians were used when neither [[sniffer dogs]] nor [[Military drone|drones]] were available.<ref name="nytimes20241014" /> An October 2024 investigation by ''[[CNN]]'' found that while the scale and scope of the practice was unknown, testimony from civilians and an Israeli soldier showed Israel's use of Palestinians as human shields was widespread across the Gaza Strip.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Krever |first1=Mick |last2=Diamond |first2=Jeremy |last3=Salman |first3=Abeer |date=24 October 2024 |title=The Israeli military has used Palestinians as human shields in Gaza, soldier and former detainees say |url=https://www.cnn.com/2024/10/24/middleeast/palestinians-human-shields-israel-military-gaza-intl/index.html |access-date=28 October 2024 |website=CNN |archive-date=14 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241114194306/https://www.cnn.com/2024/10/24/middleeast/palestinians-human-shields-israel-military-gaza-intl/index.html |url-status=live }}</ref> In November 2024, an investigation by ''[[The Washington Post]]'' further corroborated these investigations, with witnesses, victims, and an Israeli soldier stating civilians were being used as human shields to prevent harm to Israeli soldiers.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Loveluck |first1=Louisa |last2=Harb |first2=Hajar |last3=Hudson |first3=John |title=Israeli forces used civilians as human shields in Gaza, Palestinians and soldiers say |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/11/03/israel-gaza-human-shields-palestinians-idf/ |access-date=4 November 2024 |newspaper=The Washington Post}}</ref>

An investigation by the DCIP detailed that the Israeli army is "systematically" detaining and torturing children.<ref name="dci-palestine-20240821">{{cite news |date=21 August 2024 |title="They were trying to exterminate us": Palestinian children in Gaza tortured by Israeli military |url=https://www.dci-palestine.org/_they_were_trying_to_exterminate_us_palestinian_children_in_gaza_tortured_by_the_israeli_military |access-date=8 September 2024 |publisher=Defence for Children International |archive-date=8 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240908162021/https://www.dci-palestine.org/_they_were_trying_to_exterminate_us_palestinian_children_in_gaza_tortured_by_the_israeli_military |url-status=live }}</ref> Israel used several children as human shields in the Al-Tuffah area of [[Gaza City]] on 27 December 2023. On that occasion, 50 Palestinians were detained, including children. Two brothers, aged 12 and 13, told investigators that soldiers forced them to strip off, tied their hands and forced them to walk in front of Israeli tanks along with other Palestinians. The younger brother also reported being slapped, kicked and beaten.<ref name="dci-palestine-20240821" />

In November 2024, [[Defence for Children International]] reported on three separate incidents, during 15–20 October 2024, of families with young children being used as human shields to protect the [[Israel Defense Forces]] in attacks at the [[Jabalia refugee camp]] and [[Indonesia Hospital]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Israeli forces use Palestinian children as human shields in Jabalia refugee camp |url=https://www.dci-palestine.org/israeli_forces_use_palestinian_children_as_human_shields_in_jabalia_refugee_camp |access-date=26 November 2024 |website=[[Defence for Children International – Palestine]] |archive-date=26 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241126153733/https://www.dci-palestine.org/israeli_forces_use_palestinian_children_as_human_shields_in_jabalia_refugee_camp |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Deliberate targeting ==
A 2026 United Nations report found reasonable grounds to conclude that Palestinian children had been deliberately targeted by Israeli security forces during the conflict. The report documented cases of children being killed by single, precise gunshots by [[Sniper|snipers]] and drones, frequently in the head or upper torso, suggesting a deliberate intention to target them rather than incidental harm.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Bosch |first=Shannon |date=2026-06-29 |title=A UN report details the ‘overwhelming’ scale of children killed in Gaza. It raises grave legal questions |url=https://theconversation.com/a-un-report-details-the-overwhelming-scale-of-children-killed-in-gaza-it-raises-grave-legal-questions-286327 |access-date=2026-09-24 |website=The Conversation |language=en-US |doi=10.64628/AA.cvakcqdf7}}</ref>

Doctors who had undertaken medical missions in Gaza told the Commission that it appeared Israeli Defense Force (IDF) were engaging in a "game of target practice", with different parts of children's bodies reportedly being targeted on different days.<ref name=":1" />

The report also documented systematic attacks on child-essential infrastructure that had contributed to preventable child deaths and long-term disabilities. The Commission further examined dehumanising rhetoric by political leaders, soldiers and public figures, which it said contributed to an environment in which violence against Palestinian children was more readily accepted.<ref name=":1" />

==Reactions==
[[Meirav Ben-Ari]], an Israeli Knesset member, stated, "The children in Gaza brought it upon themselves."<ref>{{cite web |title=Israel-Palestine: More than 1,000 Palestinian children killed in Gaza air strikes, NGO reveals |url=https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/israel-palestine-more-than-1000-palestinian-children-killed-gaza-airstrikes-ngo-reveals |website=Middle East Eye |access-date=22 December 2023 |archive-date=6 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231206100842/https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/israel-palestine-more-than-1000-palestinian-children-killed-gaza-airstrikes-ngo-reveals |url-status=live }}</ref> Far-right Israeli Nation Security Minister [[Itamar Ben-Gvir]] called for the death of any child or woman who got too close to the border during a debate with Israeli military chief [[Herzi Halevi]], claiming that "We cannot have women and children getting close to the border... anyone who gets near must get a bullet [in the head],". Ben-Gvir claimed that the open-fire policy he was advocating for was based on the perceived use of women and children by Hamas to target Israel.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=13 February 2024 |title=Ben-Gvir says Israeli army can shoot women, children in Gaza |url=https://www.newarab.com/news/ben-gvir-says-israeli-army-can-shoot-women-children-gaza |access-date=14 February 2024 |website=The New Arab |language=en |archive-date=14 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240214182730/https://www.newarab.com/news/ben-gvir-says-israeli-army-can-shoot-women-children-gaza |url-status=live }}</ref>

During an interview on Israeli television, a former [[Mossad]] official Rami Igra who had headed the agencies "Captive and Missing Division", claimed that there were no uninvolved civilians in Gaza. He raised claims that "anyone over four is a Hamas supporter" and that only those under four could be considered children, while anyone above that age could starve.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ofir |first=Jonathan |date=15 February 2024 |title=Former Mossad official: Children in Gaza over the age of 4 deserve to be starved |url=https://mondoweiss.net/2024/02/former-mossad-official-children-in-gaza-over-the-age-of-4-deserve-to-be-starved/ |access-date=26 February 2024 |website=Mondoweiss |language=en-US |archive-date=27 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240227205308/https://mondoweiss.net/2024/02/former-mossad-official-children-in-gaza-over-the-age-of-4-deserve-to-be-starved/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Ofir |first=Jonathan |date=23 February 2024 |title=Over 2/3 of Jewish Israelis oppose humanitarian aid to Palestinians starving in Gaza |url=https://mondoweiss.net/2024/02/over-2-3-of-jewish-israelis-oppose-humanitarian-aid-to-palestinians-starving-in-gaza/ |access-date=26 February 2024 |website=Mondoweiss |language=en-US |archive-date=25 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240225233517/https://mondoweiss.net/2024/02/over-2-3-of-jewish-israelis-oppose-humanitarian-aid-to-palestinians-starving-in-gaza/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Rabbi Eliyahu Mali, the head of a [[yeshiva]] in [[Jaffa]], stated that the ongoing war was a [[mitzvah]] war and that not a soul shall live in Gaza as they will all grow up to become Hamas. When asked about babies and children in context with his comments, he stated; "Babies too?...The same thing. You can't be clever with the Torah. Today he's a baby, tomorrow he's a fighter. There are no questions here. Today's terrorists were 8-year-old children in the previous operation. So you can't To be satisfied here. That's why the Gaza law is different here."<ref>{{Cite news |last=Fox |first=Nina |date=8 March 2024 |title=ראש ישיבת הסדר ביפו: לפי העיקרון ההלכתי - להרוג את כולם בעזה, גם תינוקות |url=https://www.ynet.co.il/news/article/sy3bfhu6p |access-date=8 March 2024 |website=ynet |language=he |archive-date=8 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240308164217/https://www.ynet.co.il/news/article/sy3bfhu6p |url-status=live }}</ref>

In Gaza, a father whose one-year-old child was killed in an Israeli bombing stated, "This is a crime in which everyone participated. The US veto participated in this crime as did those Arabs and Muslims who failed to support us".<ref>{{cite web |title=Families of children killed in Gaza blame US, Arab countries |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/21/israels-war-on-gaza-live-us-ceasefire-veto-a-new-low-as-hunger-spreads?update=2722737 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=22 February 2024 |archive-date=22 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240222082808/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/21/israels-war-on-gaza-live-us-ceasefire-veto-a-new-low-as-hunger-spreads?update=2722737 |url-status=live }}</ref> The grandfather of children killed by an Israeli airstrike stated, "What wrong did those innocent children do? Were they posing any danger to Israel? Were they carrying arms?"<ref>{{cite web |title=Family, including six children, among 25 killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/18/family-including-six-children-among-23-killed-in-israeli-attacks-on-gaza |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=10 September 2024 |archive-date=10 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240910043256/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/18/family-including-six-children-among-23-killed-in-israeli-attacks-on-gaza |url-status=live }}</ref>

Marc Owen Jones wrote in a 2025 research paper, "As Israel's killing of thousands of Palestinian children and babies became harder to hide, high-profile Israeli accounts and media outlets claimed that Palestinians were fabricating casualty numbers and staging the killing of babies. The so-called '[[Pallywood]]' narrative – a derogatory term suggesting that Palestinians stage scenes of suffering for propaganda purposes – has been a recurring theme in [[disinformation]] campaigns against Gaza."<ref name="Jones-2025">{{Cite journal |last=Jones |first=Marc Owen |date=2025 |title=Evidencing alethocide: Israel's war on truth in Gaza |url=https://doi.org/10.1080/01436597.2025.2462791 |journal=[[Third World Quarterly]] |volume=0 |pages=1–18 |doi=10.1080/01436597.2025.2462791 |issn=0143-6597 |url-access=subscription |quote=The so-called 'Pallywood' narrative – a derogatory term suggesting that Palestinians stage scenes of suffering for propaganda purposes – has been a recurring theme in disinformation campaigns against Gaza.}}</ref>

===By children in Gaza===
In November 2023, a group of children outside [[al-Shifa Hospital]] held a press conference asking the world for an end to the war.<ref>{{cite web |title=Children of Gaza hold a press conference |url=https://uk.news.yahoo.com/children-gaza-hold-press-conference-134718240.html |website=Yahoo! News |access-date=9 March 2024 |date=9 November 2023 |archive-date=9 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240309050214/https://uk.news.yahoo.com/children-gaza-hold-press-conference-134718240.html |url-status=live }}</ref> A small group of children in [[Rafah]] held their own protest in advance of a planned [[Rafah offensive]] in February 2024, holding signs in English that read "We refuse to die" and "Save us from this genocide".<ref>{{cite web |title='Save us from this genocide' – Children in Rafah protest for their lives |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/15/israels-war-on-gaza-live-four-dead-as-israel-hits-city-in-lebanons-south?update=2709027 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=17 February 2024 |archive-date=17 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240217171918/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/15/israels-war-on-gaza-live-four-dead-as-israel-hits-city-in-lebanons-south?update=2709027 |url-status=live }}</ref> Children in Rafah again held their own protest against the [[Gaza Strip famine]] on 6 March, holding a banner reading "Stop our daily death".<ref>{{cite web |title='Stop our daily death' |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/3/6/israels-war-on-gaza-live-un-food-convoy-blocked-from-north-gaza-by-israel?update=2753922 |website=Al Jazeera |access-date=9 March 2024 |archive-date=9 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240309044426/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/3/6/israels-war-on-gaza-live-un-food-convoy-blocked-from-north-gaza-by-israel?update=2753922 |url-status=live }}</ref>

In February 2024, a boy wounded in an Israeli attack stated, "I don’t know why they attacked me. They are picking fights against the children of Palestine. Why?"<ref>{{cite web |title='They are picking fights against the children of Palestine. Why?' |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/22/israels-war-on-gaza-live-gaza-has-become-a-death-zone-says-who-chief?update=2725434 |access-date=24 February 2024 |website=Al Jazeera |archive-date=24 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240224020429/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/2/22/israels-war-on-gaza-live-gaza-has-become-a-death-zone-says-who-chief?update=2725434 |url-status=live }}</ref> In July 2024, a 10th grade student in [[Ramallah]] said hearing explosions on the news "just twisted something inside of me, like I felt those emotions coming out. I was scared. I was terrified, actually. It could be me next."<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hendricks |first=Kern |date=3 July 2024 |title=Young Palestinians Face a Steep Toll on Mental Health |url=https://undark.org/2024/07/03/video-mental-health-toll-palestinian-youth/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240704141651/https://undark.org/2024/07/03/video-mental-health-toll-palestinian-youth/ |archive-date=4 July 2024 |access-date=4 July 2024 |website=[[Undark Magazine]] |language=en-US}}</ref>

|url-status=live }}</ref> The [[UN Population Fund]] stated in late-March 2024 that "Pregnant women and new mothers face a constant struggle to keep themselves and their newborns alive."<ref>{{cite web |title='Constant struggle' for Gaza mothers to keep children alive: UN |url-status=live }}</ref> In response to reports that one-third of under-two-year-olds in northern Gaza were acutely malnourished, UNICEF's James Elder, stated, "That is a terrifying number".<ref>{{cite web |title='Malnutrition was never an issue in Gaza' before Israel's war: UNICEF |url-status=live }}</ref> The UN added Israel to a blacklist of countries that violate the rights of children.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Sorgi |first1=Gregorio |title=UN to add Israel to blacklist for In June 2024, the United Nations stated that grave violations against children in conflict zones had increased 155 percent globally, due especially to explosive weapons used in the Gaza Strip.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Lederer |first1=Edith M. |title=UN says violence against children in conflict reached extreme levels in 2023, including in Gaza |url=https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/violence-children-conflict-reached-extreme-levels-2023-including-111037268 |website=ABC News |publisher=Associated Press |access-date=21 June 2024 |archive-date=21 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240621215632/https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/violence-children-conflict-reached-extreme-levels-2023-including-111037268 |url-status=live }}</ref> In September 2024, a UN committee stated Israel had committed severe breaches against children's rights in Gaza, saying, "The outrageous death of children is almost historically unique. This is an extremely dark place in history. I don't think we have seen before, a violation that is so massive, as we are seeing in Gaza now".<ref>{{cite web |last1=Farge |first1=Emma |title=Israel violated global child rights treaty in Gaza, UN committee says |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-violated-global-child-rights-treaty-gaza-un-committee-says-2024-09-19/ |website=Reuters |access-date=22 September 2024}}</ref> In October 2024, members of the [[Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory]] condemned child deaths in Gaza, stating, "Kids aren't terrorists."<ref>{{cite web |title='Kids aren't terrorists': UN Independent Commission denounces killing of children in Gaza |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fjJ3xtpGTAM |website=YouTube | date=31 October 2024 |publisher=The New Arab |access-date=1 November 2024}}</ref>

Israel was added to a UN list of entities that commit violations against children.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Roth |first1=Richard |title=UN adds Israel to global list of offenders that harm children |url=https://www.cnn.com/2024/06/07/middleeast/un-israel-global-list-children-intl-latam/index.html |work=[[CNN]] |date=7 June 2024 |access-date=11 June 2024 |archive-date=10 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240610132335/https://www.cnn.com/2024/06/07/middleeast/un-israel-global-list-children-intl-latam/index.html |url-status=live}}</ref> A 2025 UN special commission concluded that "the widespread and systematic targeting of children is part of a strategy to destroy the biological continuity and future existence of the Palestinian group in Gaza, thus part of the [[Gaza genocide|intent to destroy Palestinians in Gaza]]."<ref>{{Cite web |title=Commission of Inquiry: Israeli authorities and Israeli security forces have committed and are continuing to commit genocide against the Palestinians in the Gaza Strip - Report (A/HRC/60/CRP.3) |url=https://www.un.org/unispal/document/commission-of-inquiry-report-genocide-in-gaza-a-hrc-60-crp-3/ |access-date=2025-09-24 |website=Question of Palestine |language=en-US}}</ref>
